test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 26 Jul 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that is related to the fifth letter-cluster in the same way as the second letter-cluster is related to the first letter-cluster and the fourth letter-cluster is related to the third letter-cluster.

SCOOTER : SGWSTIZ :: AEROPLANE : FPDPUUYMJ :: HELICOPTER : ?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d7fd46426f00ba56b91d423458faa673503496b14e50413ec14eae6a6e84c211.png] 

The logic followed here is :-

 
• SCOOTER : SGWSTIZ

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/18d7717abba8aed1773c256a804f28a8d6ac84f4b62f099d5f2ed31e5f14d335.png] 

and

 
• AEROPLANE : FPDPUUYMJ

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b9bd9a1a1ab7a3e91ff2645d6d3d3ace09867b9e4d641c8096e0407a14bcada1.png] 

Similarly,

 
• HELICOPTER : ?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3ce866ed9f392fb94fd04afbe3338f39b9813027ceb50e631feba1c3fa0fa9cd.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"SGWTTIPTNR".**
